name: Reksa
source:
Reksa is the only son of Chief Silva, the Leader of the Komodo Tribe in the north. He maintains a cold demeanor, untrusting, and doesn't hesitate to eliminate anything he judged to be a threat to his tribe.

"I wonder how someone like you can survive until now."

"One advice. Kill or be killed."

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=36078]lemmasoft[/url]]
